name: product-steps
title: Product Steps
description: A numbered three-step product flow with one active stage and a clear outcome.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: Separate three or four steps with bars, set active step to a one-based number, and state one outcome.

useWhen: Demonstrate 1–4 ordered actions leading to one practical outcome.
avoidWhen: Do not substitute abstract benefits for executable steps or invent features absent from the product.

inputRules.title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.steps: Supply 1–4 ordered entries separated by "|". Preserve all required content.
inputRules.outcome: Supply real outcome within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.activeStep: Use a real in-range integer; a focus index must point to an existing item.

readingOrder: Advance one real step at a time

cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches steps 1, reveal and focus the next semantic item. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches steps 2, reveal and focus the next semantic item. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches steps 3, reveal and focus the next semantic item. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-4: When narration reaches steps 4, reveal and focus the next semantic item. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Identify the outcome → Advance one real step at a time → Read the completed sequence. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
